Show a level as a sailor's biceps growing bigger and bigger

Source: R/muscle_growth.R
muscle_growth.Rd

Draws a sailor flexing both arms whose biceps grow with a level between 0 and 1: flat, skinny arms at 0 and giant biceps at 1. The sailor strains at low levels (squeezed eyes, gritted teeth, a red face and drops of sweat) and grins at high ones; the shoulders widen, the tattoos stretch, veins show and the biggest biceps sparkle. When the chart scrolls into view, the biceps grow from flat to the level while the percentage above the portrait counts up and the current stage ("Noodle arms", "Twigs", "Toned", "Strong", "Buff", "Mighty") is written under it.

Usage

muscle_growth(
  fill_level = 0.5,
  skin_color = "#e8b48f",
  hair_color = "#3b2a20",
  shirt_color = "#2a62b8",
  panel_color = "#d9ecf7",
  render_fill_label = TRUE,
  label_color = "#333",
  label_font_size = NULL,
  title_text = "Muscle growth",
  title_color = "#333",
  title_font_size = 14,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  target = NULL,
  tattoos = TRUE,
  sparkles = TRUE,
  sway = TRUE,
  draggable = FALSE,
  animate = TRUE,
  bg_col = "white",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_level

A number between 0 and 1: how big the biceps are (values outside are clamped). 0 is flat and 1 is giant. Defaults to 0.5.

skin_color

The colour of the skin. Defaults to "#e8b48f".

hair_color

The colour of the moustache, the eyebrows and the sideburns. Defaults to "#3b2a20".

shirt_color

The colour of the stripes of the tank top. Defaults to "#2a62b8".

panel_color

The colour of the card behind the portrait. Defaults to "#d9ecf7"; use NULL for no card.

render_fill_label

Logical. Show the percentage and the stage above the portrait. Defaults to TRUE.

label_color

The colour of the percentage, the stage, the target and the speech bubble. Defaults to "#333".

label_font_size

Optional. The font size of the percentage, a number or a CSS size such as "16px". By default it grows with the chart.

title_text

Optional. A caption below the portrait. Defaults to "Muscle growth"; use NULL to hide it.

title_color

The colour of the caption. Defaults to "#333".

title_font_size

The font size of the caption, a number or a CSS size such as "14px". Defaults to 14.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

target

Optional. A level between 0 and 1, drawn as a dashed outline of the biceps at that size and written in the top right corner.

tattoos

Logical. Draw an anchor and a heart tattoo on the arms; they stretch as the biceps grow. Defaults to TRUE.

sparkles

Logical. Let the biggest biceps (above 85 percent) sparkle. Defaults to TRUE.

sway

Logical. Let the sailor breathe and blink, the weak arms tremble and the sea move. Defaults to TRUE.

draggable

Logical. Let the viewer change the level by dragging or with the arrow keys. Defaults to FALSE.

animate

Logical. Grow the biceps from flat when the chart first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

  • Move the mouse across the chart: the eyes follow it.

  • Hover the portrait: the biceps twitch.

  • Click the portrait: the sailor flexes harder, the cap jumps and a speech bubble pops up.

  • With draggable = TRUE, drag up to grow the biceps and down to shrink them, or focus the chart (click it or press Tab) and use the arrow keys (1 percent per press, 10 with Shift).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking the portrait sets input$id_clicked to a list with value and stage, and, with draggable = TRUE, setting a level sets input$id_value to the new level (a number between 0 and 1). When the chart is re-rendered with a new level, the biceps grow or shrink from the old size to the new one.

Examples

muscle_growth(fill_level = 1)


muscle_growth(0.3, target = 0.75, title_text = "Training plan completed")


muscle_growth(
  fill_level = 0.6,
  skin_color = "#8d5a3b",
  hair_color = "#1f1a17",
  shirt_color = "#c0392b",
  panel_color = "#fdf1e3",
  draggable = TRUE,
  title_text = "Drag up to pump the biceps"
)
